Subject: AWS Marketplace — pricing window & buyer clearance steps

Hi Liam / Emily —

Following our demo last week, I put together two straightforward private-offer options you can circulate for internal approval. We want to keep the activation window tight so billing and co-sell routing happen in one go. High-level:

- Option A (12-month): 20% off list for usage billed monthly. Faster activation window; minimal procurement approvals (procurement + legal).
- Option B (24-month): 30% off list, annual billing. Preferred by finance but requires CFO sign-off and extended activation runway.

We can also include a pilot-to-commit clause that lets you start with a 3-month pilot and automatically convert to the longer term if you submit a PO within 60 days. That helps procurement with budget runway while giving your product team time to validate.

Required evidence for procurement: SOC 2 + basic network diagram + data handling summary. I attached a short evidence summary and the initial PO terms draft (see attachments).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tell me which option procurement prefers (A or B) and who the signer will be.
2) If procurement needs unitized pricing (per thousand tokens / per embed), tell me and I’ll include a line-item table.
3) If you want DocuSign we can send the private-offer link once you confirm the signer.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 — I’ll update as you confirm.

Attachments: CareNext_evidence_summary.pdf, po_terms_v1.docx

Thanks — talk soon.
Naomi
Head of Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference

Emily — looping you to drive procurement gating. I think a pilot-to-commit would be ideal to get our internal teams ramped.

Subject: Fwd: CareNext procurement asks — quick decision needed

Team — forwarding CareNext’s procurement checklist (below). They will likely start with Option A unless we provide the CFO memo and unitized pricing. Two internal decisions: pricing flexibility and whether we can accept a pilot-to-commit clause that converts to a 24mo if they PO within 60 days.

My recommendation: approve a clean Option A activation (12mo, 20% off) but approve a conditional addendum that allows conversion to 24mo at a 28% effective discount (rather than full 30%) if CFO signs within the pilot window. This protects our margin while giving procurement a path to finance approval.

Notes on approvals mapping:
- Procurement signoff (Emily) — required for activation.
- Legal review (CareNext) — should be quick if we keep standard AWS Marketplace private-offer terms.
- CFO (finance) — required for multi-year; expect 7–10 business days.

Risk items: co-sell crediting — if we shorten the activation window we may lose the optimal co-sell routing window for the current quarter (Q1). Recommend offering a $15k credit to offset and keep the deal in the quarter for sales crediting reasons.

I attached an internal approval matrix for your quick sign-off. Please reply with one-line "approve" or specific edits.

Attachments: approval_matrix.csv

—Naomi

- Convert-to-24 addendum: if CareNext issues a PO for 24 months within 60 days, the contract will convert at an effective 28% discount and apply a $15k co-sell credit at activation.

I’ve attached the revised private-offer PDF. If that looks good I can push the private offer to AWS Marketplace and send a DocuSign link — here is the staging link to review before I send the official DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/offer-DEAL-2026-0421
